blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Welcome to your first accounting week at Czarnikow. Accounting is the language of the company's numbers. This is a good place to start.

Today's lesson is called "My First Accounting Week". It gives you short, useful sentences. You can use them with the finance team.

You will learn five new words. You will practise them in easy sentences. Go slowly — one step at a time. English comes in cans, not in can'ts. You can do it!

items.q: What is the reader's first week of?
items.why: "Welcome to your first accounting week at Czarnikow."

items.q: In the text, accounting is called…
options: the language of the company's numbers
items.why: "Accounting is the language of the company's numbers."

items.q: How many new words will the reader learn?
items.why: "You will learn five new words."

items.q: The author would most likely AGREE that…
options: you must learn everything in one day
items.why: Inferência: "Go slowly — one step at a time" mostra que o autor prefere calma, não pressa.

items.q: What does "You can do it!" suggest about the author?
options: The author thinks the reader will fail
The author wants to encourage the reader
items.why: Inferência: a frase é um incentivo — o autor quer dar confiança ao leitor.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sophie recebendo um novo colega na equipe de contabilidade. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi! Welcome to the accounting team. My name is Sophie, and I am very happy to meet you.

This is your first week. Please do not worry. We start slowly here. Every day you learn one small thing, and then you practise it. Little by little, you become confident.

Accounting is not scary. It is just clear, honest numbers. When the numbers match the records, everything is fine. That is the whole job.

Here is my plan for you. In the morning, we look at the numbers together. In the afternoon, you try on your own. If you have a question, just ask me. There are no silly questions here.

Our team is small, but we are kind, and we help each other. By Friday, you will feel ready. You will know the words, and you will use them with the finance team.

So take a deep breath. One step at a time. English comes in cans, not in can'ts. You can do it, and I am sure of it!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What does Sophie do?
options: She works on the accounting team
items.why: "Welcome to the accounting team. My name is Sophie."

items.q: In the morning, what do they do together?
items.why: "In the morning, we look at the numbers together."

items.q: According to Sophie, when the numbers match the records…
items.why: "When the numbers match the records, everything is fine."

items.q: Sophie says "There are no silly questions here." This suggests that she wants the new colleague to…
items.why: Inferência: ela tira o medo de perguntar — quer que a pessoa pergunte à vontade.

items.q: How does Sophie feel about the new colleague's first week?
items.why: Inferência: "You can do it, and I am sure of it!" mostra um tom de apoio e confiança.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "This is my first week at Czarnikow." A week is…
items.why: Week = semana, sete dias.

items.q: "I want to learn new words every day." To learn means to…
items.why: Learn = aprender, ganhar conhecimento novo.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "I ___ my English every day, so I speak better and better."
items.why: Practise = praticar, repetir para melhorar.

items.q: "After a lot of practice, I feel confident." Confident means…
items.why: Confident = confiante, seguro de si.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "My report is finished. It is ___ for your signature."
items.why: Ready = pronto, preparado para ser usado.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem no primeiro dia de trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Please fill in this form with your name." To fill in means to…
items.why: Fill in = preencher, escrever a informação que falta.

items.q: "Please hand in your report by Friday." To hand in means to…
items.why: Hand in = entregar um trabalho pronto.

items.q: "Let's go over the numbers together." To go over means to…
items.why: Go over = revisar, olhar com atenção.

items.q: "The manager has to sign off on the report." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar formalmente, dar o aval.

items.q: "When you arrive, please check in at the front desk." To check in means to…
items.why: Check in = registrar sua chegada, avisar que você chegou.
